newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 23.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 173.38 points, or 2.60 percent, at 6,833.59 as blue-chip stocks posted their second-largest daily gain ever as investors sought safety in big-name shares.

* President Suharto has ordered Trade and Industry Minister Tungky Ariwibowo and Home Affairs Minister Yogie S. Memet to issue regulations which would ban big retailers from entering markets in regencies in order to help small businesses and cooperatives.
* On Tuesday, the composite index rose 3.98 points, or 0.62 percent, to close at 646.24 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,417.75/18.25 at 0130 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,418.50/19.50.
* Small-sized property firm Elang Realty on market talk of a possible rights issue.
* Banks including BNI and BII following active bargain hunting on Tuesday.
* Retailers Matahari, Ramayana and Multipolar MPPL.JK following reports of a proposed regulation banning big retailers from entering markets in regencies.
* Toll road operator Citra Marga on a newspaper report quoting finance director Tito Sulistyo as saying the firm expected its net profit to grow by 22 percent to 150 billion rupiah in 1997.
